description: BYOK. Look up an Australian Business Number (ABN): returns legal entity name, entity type, ABN status (active/cancelled) with effective date, GST registration, address state/postcode, and registered business names. Requires your own ABR web-services GUID via _apiKey (register free at https://abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServices). Example: abn_lookup({ abn: "37067751151", _apiKey: "your-guid" })

_apiKey.description: Your ABR web-services GUID. Requires an API key — this pack is BYOK: there is no platform key. Register free at https://abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServices (accept the Web Services Agreement to receive a GUID by email).

abn.description: Australian Business Number, 11 digits, with or without spaces (e.g. "37 067 751 151" or "37067751151").

name: abn_lookup
